units.source_text: 紫姬目见耳闻，不能无动于衷。

en.t: Lady Murasaki saw and heard it all, and could not remain unmoved.

units.source_text: 其实，虽然来了个三公主，紫姬未必全被压倒。

en.t: In truth, although the Third Princess had arrived, Lady Murasaki was not necessarily overwhelmed by her.

units.source_text: 然而紫姬一向专宠，无人能与并肩；

en.t: Yet Lady Murasaki had always held Genji's exclusive favor, with no one able to stand beside her.

units.source_text: 如今新来的人姿色既艳，年纪又轻，威势盛大，足可凌人，

en.t: Now the newcomer was both strikingly beautiful and young, with a lofty rank and influence great enough to overshadow others,
and this instead made her unable to feel at ease.

units.source_text: 但她绝不形之于色，当新人入门之时，她和源氏一起准备迎接，

en.t: But she never showed it on her face, and when the new bride entered the household, she prepared to welcome her together with Genji.

units.source_text: 事无巨细，都料理得十分周到。

en.t: In matters large and small, she arranged everything with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 源氏看到这般模样，觉得此人越发可敬可爱了。

en.t: Seeing her conduct herself in this way, Genji found her all the more admirable and lovable.

units.source_text: 三公主年纪还小，尚未完全发育，而且态度又极幼稚，竟是一个孩子。

en.t: The Third Princess was still very young, not yet fully grown, and her manner was so childish that she was practically a child.

units.source_text: 源氏回想起从前在北山访得与藤壶妃子有缘的紫姬时的情状，

en.t: Genji recalled the time long ago when he found Lady Murasaki at Kitayama, the girl connected by blood to Lady Fujitsubo,

units.source_text: 觉得紫姬当这年龄时已露才气，颇有劲儿了，

en.t: and he felt that at this age Lady Murasaki had already shown talent and quite a spirited strength.

units.source_text: 而三公主则完全是个小孩。

en.t: The Third Princess, by contrast, was entirely a little child.

units.source_text: 源氏看了她的模样，觉得这样也好，免得妒忌或骄横；

en.t: Looking at her, Genji thought this might be for the best, since it would spare him jealousy or arrogance.
Yet in the end, she was far too uninteresting.
